verdict.rationale: 1Password ships automation surfaces (CLI, service accounts, Connect, SDKs), so asking whether those automations can be versioned and rolled back is a fair question. The evidence pack has nothing on versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automation definitions. The Events API and SDK item management are adjacent features, not versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
